name: Hinting the Entire Area
summary: During warmup, touch everywhere around the vulva except the spot you're hinting at—smooth arcs from thigh to thigh that come close then deliberately veer away to other erogenous zones, building anticipation before any direct contact.
detailed_description: OMGYES reports about 65% of women love this approach. The giver makes passes that approach the vulva or clitoris then change course toward inner thighs, belly, navel, mons pubis, or surrounding labia instead of the lips or clit themselves. The feeling is of nearly arriving and then taking the scenic route—near-misses that keep the area waiting.
stepwise_structure: 1. Stay in warmup—no direct clitoral contact or penetration yet.
2. Touch gently all around the genital area without neglecting any nearby zone.

5. Keep passes light and varied so the near-misses stay engaging.
6. Sustain across several minutes before allowing more direct touch.
safety_notes: Keep pressure light; this is teasing, not massage with force.
Indulge the target eventually—endless avoidance can frustrate rather than build.
